name: add_component
title: Add Component
description: Add a component to a game object, optionally setting its properties in the same call. The user can undo this. Returns the component's id.

id.description: The game object's id, from scene_tree or find_game_objects.

type.description: The component type name, e.g. 'ModelRenderer'. get_component_type documents what exists.

properties.description: Optional json object of property values, e.g. {"LightColor": "1,0.8,0.6,1", "Radius": 512}.
